'''All Good Things Remastered''' is the 60th virtual expansion of [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[The Continuing Committee]] on 5 December 2025. The set consists of 41 virtual cards.

The Continuing Committee brings the celebration of the game's 30th anniversary to a fabulous finale with All Good Things Remastered, featuring all 40 of Decipher's final run expansion in high definition. Featuring tweaks and modernizations, these cards look better than ever. All Good Things Remastered features corrected lore references and modern wording, but don't fret - the original spirit of these cards remains!
